main_text.p: oris Fidei Specimen. Sic Ille. Non impar sane, aut incom-
moda Collatio Ignatii & Socini. Utrque genere no-
bilis. Utrque mundum & mundana, saltem in speciem,
deseruit. Utrque duros labores tulit. Utrque Dei ze-
lum, & Fidei militiam professus est. Utrque novae Se-
ctae Author, e diametro quidem alterutrimque oppo-
sitae, sed aeque perniciosae. Utrumque demum Animi
magnitudo (ut illi loqui libet) revera malesana
Ambitio, & Superbia, & inanis Gloriae Cupiditas,
egit et impulit, ad novam Religionis fabricam, Sec-
tamque formandam. Socini autem eo major Gloria
ex hujus Scriptoris sententia, quod Hic novae quo-
que Fidei Typum, seu nobilioris Fidei Specimen (ut
loqui amat) excogitaverit, & orbi Christiano fu-
scipiendum exhibuerit. Par sane Gloria utriusque,
par merces utrique debita est.

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the scan; the page number may be printed as "II" (11). The first line starts mid-word ("rja"), so the opening fragment is kept as printed. Words marked [?] are uncertain: "despicie", the hyphen after "non", "suis" (printed form looks like "Iuis"), and the word "ut," on the last full line, which looks irregular in the scan and may be a printing error. Italic type is judged from the scan for the first lines. The text shows show-through from the reverse side in places; it is not transcribed.
